title: Artifact Intermediate Representation (AIR)
description: The mandatory upfront authoring contract for every NXT consulting hashtag deliverable EXCEPT #proto. Every artifact skill produces AIR BEFORE any prose, slide payload, or HTML. AIR forces decision-grade thinking (evidence ledger + insight hierarchy) before output, and carries render_plan.slide_role so template selection is driven by NARRATIVE INTENT against the live Figma COMPONENT REGISTRY (wiki/brand/figma-node-map.md), never by the hashtag. Derived from the nxt-consulting-artifact-architect proposal (2026-06-16), converged onto the HiC registry + render gate + SkillOpt. #proto is EXCLUDED - it uses its own intermediate representation (the orchestrator AppShellContract in services/prototypeBuilder.ts).

brief.description: Who this is for and what decision it supports.

artifact_type.description: canonical artifact id, e.g. strategy-deck, strategic-recommendation, capability-gap, journey-map

hashtag.description: the directive that resolved this skill, e.g. #strategy

brand.description: brand MODE; drives the Figma token mode (NXT 221:0 / NU 535:0). Never a separate file.

audience.description: the executive/role who must act on this

business_question.description: the single question the artifact answers

decision_supported.description: the specific decision the audience must make

evidence_ledger.description: Every non-obvious claim must trace to an entry here by claim_id. Distinguish observed evidence from inference, and external research from client interviews (>=50% external per the Evidence Hierarchy in .claude/CLAUDE.md).

claim_id.description: stable id referenced by payload + render_plan, e.g. C001

statement.description: the claim or the verbatim quote

source_name.description: NAMED source: 'Higher Ed Dive', 'Reddit r/NEU', 'OpenAlex: Smith 2024', 'Riley Quinn - NU Advancement'. Never 'research'/'data'/'sources'.

source_type.description: external_* counts toward the >=50% external floor

kind.description: observed = quoted/evidenced; inference = model judgment (must state what would validate it)

verbatim_quote.description: the exact quote when kind=observed; required for anything labeled 'Evidence'

validates_with.description: for kind=inference: what evidence would confirm it

insight_hierarchy.description: The decision-grade spine (Minto/SCQA + Rumelt's kernel). The artifact is a CHOICE, not a research dump.

situation.description: the fact pattern the client recognizes

complication.description: why the current path will not work

strategic_choice.description: the decision that matters now (a decision, not a goal)

moves.description: the few actions that change the trajectory

artifact_payload.description: The artifact-specific content object. Its shape is defined per-artifact in _shared/air-authoring-contract.md and MUST match the renderer's data type in components/slideTemplates/types.ts (e.g. JourneyMapData, CaseStudyData, RecommendationData).

render_plan.description: How the argument becomes visual. Template selection is driven by slide_role against the Figma COMPONENT REGISTRY (wiki/brand/figma-node-map.md) - NOT by the hashtag.

density.description: raises per-template item ceilings via DENSITY_SPEC; raises ceilings not floors

slide_role.description: narrative role -> maps to a registered slide template in types.ts SlideTemplate + the Figma COMPONENT REGISTRY

title.description: a CONCLUSION (judgment), not a topic label; carries no naked numbers (Quantitative Claim Rule)

visual_intent.description: what the slide must make the reader see/feel

claim_ids.description: every claim_id must exist in evidence_ledger

template_constraints.description: density / item-count limits the content must respect

quality_report.description: Populated by scripts/score_artifact.py + the objective quality gate + (optional) the artifact-review subagent + human score. Feeds the SkillOpt self-improvement loop.
